stem: Which measurements are included in a paediatric growth assessment?

options.text: Head circumference and abdominal girth only

explanation: Weight, height/length, and head circumference are the core measurements used in a paediatric growth assessment.

citations.source: Louisa Leone MD3 2025 - Child and Adolescent Health - Study Notes.pdf
citations.title: Page 12

optionExplanations.A: Correct because weight, height/length, and head circumference are the standard anthropometric measurements included in growth assessment.
optionExplanations.B: Incorrect because abdominal girth and temperature are not part of the standard growth assessment measurements.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because blood pressure and pulse are vital signs, not the core measurements used to assess growth.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because weight alone does not complete a growth assessment; height/length and head circumference are also needed.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because head circumference and abdominal girth alone omit weight and height/length, which are required for growth assessment.
